items.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
items.summary: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged. The post Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
items.summary: SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code. The post SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised appeared first on SecurityWeek .
